intent: Inspect a food truck parking booking payment before confirming host payout.

required_real_data.value_reference: must come from MealScout booking system
must be host-set price in cents

action.description: Confirm vendor payment for host price plus processing plus $10 MealScout fee.

fail_safes: Do not confirm booking without real host and vendor records.
Do not make the host absorb the $10 MealScout fee.
Do not issue payout decisions without payment status.
